compatibility.source: Verified by EasyPlay on an M4 Mac, Game Porting Toolkit 3.0
notes: Not a game. A free 64-bit DirectX 11 benchmark, used to prove the DirectX-to-Metal path actually engages.

Verified 2026-09-07: the running process maps D3DMetal.framework, libmetalirconverter (DXIL to Metal IR shader conversion) and the AGXMetalG16G Apple GPU driver. DirectX 11 reaches the M4 GPU through Metal.

Superposition's own log reports the adapter as 'AMD Compatibility Mode' with 18186 MB of video memory - D3DMetal exposing the Mac's unified memory. The contrast with a wined3d fallback, which invents an 'NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GTX' with 4095 MB, is the quickest way to tell the two apart.
Chosen specifically because it is 64-bit: its predecessor Heaven 4.0 ships a 32-bit engine and therefore can never reach D3DMetal.

hints: Inno Setup installer, run unattended. About 4 GB once installed.

knownIssues.title: DirectX 11 device couldn't be created
knownIssues.fix: The DirectX-to-Metal layer didn't start. Check that this bottle uses the Game Porting Toolkit engine.
